tokens.name: signal-supply-pos
tokens.usage: Positive supply rail, +V. Red banana jacks, +V leads, the +V figure on the supply readout. Never used for anything that is not the positive rail.

tokens.name: signal-supply-neg
tokens.usage: Negative supply rail, -V. Blue jacks and leads. Paired with a printed -V legend at every terminal, never colour alone.

tokens.name: signal-ground
tokens.usage: Common / 0 V. Black jacks, leads and the board's common rail. Carries a white outline wherever it sits on a dark panel.

tokens.name: signal-input
tokens.usage: Input signal, Vin / Vin1. Amber jacks and leads from the generator to the board.

tokens.name: signal-input-b
tokens.usage: Second input, Vin2. Violet. Only visible in the adder and difference configurations.

tokens.name: signal-feedback
tokens.usage: Feedback path, Rf back to the inverting input. Green. The one colour a student should be able to trace at a glance.

tokens.name: signal-output
tokens.usage: Output, Vout from pin 6. Orange, deliberately distinct from the amber input.

tokens.name: case-shell
tokens.usage: Moulded instrument shell. Warm neutral grey; never white, which blooms under bench light and in a headset.

tokens.name: case-panel
tokens.usage: Recessed front panel plate. Dark graphite so the printed legend and the coloured jacks both read against it.

tokens.name: case-trim
tokens.usage: Plated trim: jack bezels, screw heads, knob collars.

tokens.name: panel-legend
tokens.usage: Printed legend on case-panel. 7.1:1 on case-panel.

tokens.name: panel-legend-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary printed text: units, ranges, model numbers. 4.6:1 on case-panel. Never below 2.5 mm cap height.

tokens.name: readout-field
tokens.usage: The dark glass of a display window, behind every live figure.

tokens.name: readout-primary
tokens.usage: Live measured figures on readout-field. 11.4:1. The colour of a value the instrument is reading right now.

tokens.name: readout-trace-a
tokens.usage: Oscilloscope CH1, carrying Vin. Matches signal-input so the trace and the lead agree.

tokens.name: readout-trace-b
tokens.usage: Oscilloscope CH2, carrying Vout. Chosen for lightness separation from CH1 rather than hue alone.

tokens.name: readout-graticule
tokens.usage: Scope graticule rules on readout-field.

tokens.name: board-body
tokens.usage: Breadboard ABS. Slightly warm so it separates from the white of a printed label.

tokens.name: board-recess
tokens.usage: The moulded square recess of a tie point.

tokens.name: bench-top
tokens.usage: ESD laminate benchtop. Dark, so light instruments and pale cables sit clearly on it.

tokens.name: room-floor
tokens.usage: Laboratory vinyl floor.

tokens.name: room-wall
tokens.usage: Room walls and ceiling.

tokens.name: state-next
tokens.usage: The one next action in guided mode: a pulsing ring on the socket, knob or probe to touch next. Only ever one on screen.

tokens.name: state-valid
tokens.usage: A connection that will be accepted on release.

tokens.name: state-blocked
tokens.usage: A connection that will be refused, and why.

tokens.name: state-selected
tokens.usage: The lead or probe currently held or inspected.

tokens.name: ui-surface
tokens.usage: Desktop control rail and guidance panel ground.

tokens.name: ui-surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and grouped controls on ui-surface.

tokens.name: ui-ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ui-surface. 13.9:1 light, 13.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: ui-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and units on ui-surface. 5.6:1 light, 6.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: ui-rule
tokens.usage: Hairline between control groups. Never a shadow; this system separates with rules.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Instrument name. 8.0 mm cap height on the panel — legible at 1.4 m, so it reads the moment you turn toward the bench.

styles.name: panel-legend
styles.usage: Every control and terminal label. 6.0 mm cap — 20 arcmin at 1.0 m. This is the floor for anything read from the standing position, which is all four instrument panels.

styles.name: panel-micro
styles.usage: Units and selector positions. 4.5 mm cap — 20 arcmin at 0.75 m. Permitted ONLY within arm's reach; never for anything a student must read while standing back.

styles.name: readout-xl
styles.usage: The one figure an instrument exists to show. 15 mm cap — readable from anywhere in the room.

styles.name: readout-lg
styles.usage: Supply rails and generator settings. 8.0 mm cap.

styles.name: readout-sm
styles.usage: Scope scale factors and channel labels. 5.5 mm cap — 20 arcmin at 0.95 m, which is where the scope sits.

styles.name: step-number
styles.usage: The numeral in a step chip, 1 to 4.

styles.name: step-title
styles.usage: Control group heading in the rail and on the guidance panel.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Connect Rf between pin 6 and pin 2.

spacing.note: Every dimension in this laboratory is a multiple of the 0.1 inch breadboard pitch. 1 pitch = 2.54 mm. Instrument widths, jack spacing and bench layout all land on this grid, which is why the hardware looks like it was manufactured rather than drawn.

tokens.name: pitch
tokens.usage: 0.1 in. The base unit. One tie-point spacing, and the pin pitch of every DIP package.

tokens.name: pitch-2
tokens.usage: Two pitches. Jack bezel clearance, silkscreen offset from a terminal.

tokens.name: pitch-4
tokens.usage: Four pitches. Minimum gap between adjacent panel controls.

tokens.name: pitch-8
tokens.usage: Eight pitches. Panel margin; spacing between banana jacks.

tokens.name: pitch-12
tokens.usage: Twelve pitches. Knob centre-to-centre.

tokens.name: pitch-20
tokens.usage: Twenty pitches. Gap between instruments on the bench.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Front panel plate corners and display apertures. Nearly square: a panel is a cut plate, not a card.

tokens.name: radius-case
tokens.usage: Moulded case corners and keycaps.

tokens.name: radius-case-lg
tokens.usage: The outer shell of a large case, and the breadboard body.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Jacks, knobs, LEDs and the step chips.
